product_outcome: Preserve exact explicitly declared requirements through objective transitions and restart, and deliver the current set to the model.

business_prototype.value: Avoid losing constraints when work is interrupted or resumed.
business_prototype.completion: Current exact snapshots reach dispatched context; invalid state dispatches nothing.

definitions.meaning: Bind existing requirement snapshots to each retained objective and checkpoint them with its existing resolution event. No new canonical term or authority.

selected_nodes.meaning: The canonical append-only hash-chained sequence of explicit reasoning products from which immutable reasoning-state epochs are selected.
A digest-bound flush receipt proving that one verified reasoning-state epoch reached its declared durability posture before a model request, effect, or continuation boundary advanced.

The immediate desired result, with source request, scope, completion condition, relation to broader work and unresolved questions. It is distinct from a route, an objective-kind label and permission to act.
An evidence-bound relationship between a new request and active work: continue, refine, replace, interrupt or new objective. Preserve suspended work without assuming permission to resume it.
Interpret a request against selected active state, classify its relationship to ongoing work and establish an explicit immediate objective before committing to its route.

interface.seed_provider: Synchronous host callback receives frozen {request, request_ref, state}; returns existing are.objective-requirements/v1 bound to that next state and including request_ref in source_refs. No model or IO adapter is installed.
interface.resolution: Local expanded add/remove/keep grammar first; explicit active continue retains all; explicit new/replace/interrupt/resume uses existing objective grammar. Otherwise existing optional objective provider supplies full checked delta for the active snapshot within unchanged deadline.
interface.persistence: One requirement continuity record in the existing objective-transition-resolved event; all retained objective snapshots rebind to next state; verify predecessor set and replay before accepting.
interface.limits: 17 snapshots and 32 KiB aggregate; no truncation. Existing 64 requirement/source-ref cap remains.
interface.authority: none; a resolved interpretation is not a dispatch receipt or permission

open_questions: Host source verification for initial seeds
